newsitem.title: USA: Nash Finch passes waiting period.
newsitem.headline: Nash Finch passes waiting period.

text.p: Nash Finch Co said Tuesday it received notification that the waiting period under the Hart-Scott-Rodino Antitrust Improvements Act has terminated, removing a possible hindrance to its tender for Super Food Services Inc.
As previously announced, Nash Finch is offering $15.50 per share for all outstanding shares of Super Food. Unless extended, the offer is scheduled to expire at midnight EST on November 6.
As of October 28, a total of about 1,085,664 shares, or 10 percent of Super Food common had been tendered.
